info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Deposit Lending Loan-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Loan Submission API facilitates the creation of loan applications for deposit lending. This endpoint allows financial institutions and lending services to initiate the loan process for clients seeking to secure funds against their deposits. Typical consumers include banks and fintech platforms that offer deposit-backed loan products. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their lending operations and enhance customer service through quick processing of loan applications.

post.summary: Create a new deposit lending loan.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new loan within the deposit lending service. It requires specific loan details to be provided in the request body, allowing for the initialization of a loan tailored to user needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a loan operation under the deposit lending service. It requires specific information about the loan request.
